_comment: Public rules for tools/release_scan.py (--public-rules). Nothing private: the one public identity, the reviewed waivers and size allowances of the export, the scanner's own planted phrases, and the paths that may never be tracked.
Paths are relative to the public repository root. The private denylist, lab path patterns and extra waivers stay in ~/.config/solostone/lab.json (HS_LAB_CONFIG) and merge in after these.
CI: release_scan.py --public-rules tools/release_scan.public.json --allow-no-private-config --source . --skip-git, and --commits origin/main..HEAD for the identity-free commit checks.
Waivers 1-5 are carried over from tools/release_export.json (same owner rulings). The `text` form only covers a hit whose own source line holds that text.

In the git modes (hooks) the guard ignores media_allow, large_allow, card_data and allowed_emails from this file, and waivers of privacy, path, Blizzard, lab-path, IL, decompiler, game-dll, asset-bundle, forbidden-path and git rules: those come from the private lab config. The hooks also refuse unless the sha256 of this file, release_scan.py, privacy_scan.py and installer/stage.py match the pins in private/guard_rails.json (guard_rails.py repin, after review).

Spelled with \u0020 / \u0040 escapes where a banned phrase or e-mail address appears, so this file passes its own scan; JSON readers see the plain text. A waiver's count caps it at that many hits per file.
